scope: Instances of the Becoming core's countdown laws in the correction and shutdown protocols. Kept along admitted histories: the mediated and the recoverable History are reachability under the steps each protocol's law takes where its source law admits the event, so coverage and safety are kept along every history, interruptions included, exactly because each admitted step keeps them (Countdown.admitted_invariant_iff); the original history theorems are instances. Supported completion: a pending recovery is counted work, so n remaining writes and the publication complete in n + 1 resumed steps exactly when the reserve covers n + 1 units and the deadline n + 1 more steps, and no shorter resumption publishes (Countdown.completes_iff, pending_before). Reserved stop: the shutdown supervisor is a reserved exit, so every admissible schedule runs and stays valid and every admissible schedule longer than the margin above the three reserved units stops (Countdown.runs_valid, exits); every_supported_schedule_finishes is an instance. Correspondence of these machines to actual devices, authorities or recoveries is not checked.
